exposure: early nutritional support during the first week of life
parenteral protein > 3.5 g/kg/d during the first week
feeding type (formula, mixed feed, breast milk)
outcome: BPD severity at 36 weeks postmenstrual age
cohort: The study enrolled 1286 very preterm infants born at a gestational age < 32 weeks, who were < 72 hours after birth and had a respiratory score > 4, from 40 tertiary neonatal intensive care units across mainland China.
finding: A longer duration to achieve full enteral nutrition in very preterm infants was associated with increased BPD development, while breastfeeding demonstrated a protective effect against BPD.
birth_weight: N/A (birth weight was a measured factor but not an explicit inclusion criterion)
